svg.title: CKE Long-Context CPU Inference: Keeping Compute, Cache, DRAM, and Storage in Flow
svg.desc: A technical infographic synthesizing the C-Kernel-Engine reference dossier. It shows a left-to-right execution pipeline from GGUF weights through circuit resolution, kernel-map provider selection, IR lowering, and generated C runtime. A memory hierarchy illustrates DRAM, L3, L1, and compute tile relationships. A recurrent versus full-attention layer timeline distinguishes bounded-state layers from global-context layers. A two-node ZIP reduction diagram shows weight-sharded distributed execution with hidden-state merges. NVMe Memory Tetris depicts lifetime-aware DRAM arena reuse over a backing tier. Quantized Q4/Q5/Q6 weight representations, persistent thread pools, planner-owned scratch, X-Ray numerical parity evidence, and DRAM/L3/compute constraint equations are all shown. Measured evidence is marked green; future architecture is marked blue.
svg.text: CKE Long-Context CPU Inference: Keeping Compute, Cache, DRAM, and Storage in Flow
EXECUTION PIPELINE — GGUF to Generated C Runtime
weight shards · KV cache · activations · scratch arena
current tile resident · next tile streaming from DRAM
SIMD register file · AVX-512 / AMX compute
T_r = max( B_fresh,r / Σ BW_i,r , F_r / Σ F_i,r ) + C_r(N)
Prefill: T queries → GEMM/compute dominated · AI grows with T
Decode: 1 query → bandwidth dominated · every weight byte read once
● Measured: i7-14700T AVX2/VNNI · Xeon AVX-512 · TDA4VM NEON
TWO-NODE ZIP REDUCTION — WEIGHT-SHARDED DISTRIBUTED CPU
○ Future: C_r(N) measured on RDMA fabric · proportional shards by X-Ray throughput
● Measured: single-node kernel times · per-region B_fresh · GEMM throughput
○ Memory Tetris: research design · fail-closed contracts · immutable weights first
● X-Ray: active parity gates · rolling llama.cpp compat · PyTorch FP32 training
Prepared: unpacked tiles · scale-decoded · AVX-512/AMX aligned
Kernel map quant block: {weight, activation, output} dtype match
● Measured: bit-exact llama.cpp parity on Q4/Q5/Q6/Q8
Persistent pthreads · no per-op spawn · dispatch at codegen layer
NO OpenMP in kernels · parallelization owned by orchestrator
Per-phase preferred strategy: split-by-tokens vs split-by-features
Affinity + NUMA-aware · reduction_order declared per kernel
NO malloc/free in kernels · pointers passed in · bump allocator
Scratch arena: per-op workspace · deterministic offsets at compile time
Persistent state: KV cache (storage_class: state) · append index
Canaries + alias checks · fail-closed on overlap or incomplete slot
Filters: contract → phase → dtype → shape → layout → ISA → alias
Rank: direction → activation pref → lifecycle → priority (in-group)
Fail-closed: tie = HARD FAULT · zero match = compile error
● Measured: X-Ray trace · ratchet migration scoreboard
Generated from a 128K-token CKE reference dossier
